<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.28"/>
    </filter>
    <linearGradient id="redGlow" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF4D4D"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#990000"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#121826"/>
  <circle cx="338" cy="116" r="104" fill="#8B232359"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="258" r="120" fill="#FF4E0040"/>
  <circle cx="330" cy="510" r="75" fill="#990000" opacity="0.22"/>
  <polygon points="0,535 92,452 150,535" fill="#8B232359" opacity="0.55"/>
  <polygon points="390,205 340,255 390,302" fill="#FF4D4D" opacity="0.18"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="126" r="8" fill="#FEC949"/>
  <circle cx="101" cy="102" r="4" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
  <circle cx="303" cy="177" r="5" fill="#F8A0A0"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="20" y="24" font-family="Roboto Mono" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="310" y1="19" x2="310" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="315" y1="16" x2="315" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

  <rect x="353" y="16" width="16" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="374" y="17" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="30" cy="73" r="18" fill="#990000"/>
    <rect x="20" y="69" width="20" height="10" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="25" cy="81" r="3" fill="#121826"/>
    <circle cx="35" cy="81" r="3" fill="#121826"/>

    <text x="58" y="78" font-family="Source Sans Pro" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Tirana Bus</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="298" y="59" width="70" height="29" rx="15" fill="#35383F"/>
    <circle cx="316" cy="73" r="7" fill="#FEC949"/>
    <circle cx="316" cy="73" r="3" fill="#35383F"/>
    <line x1="316" y1="61" x2="316" y2="64" stroke="#35383F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="316" y1="82" x2="316" y2="85" stroke="#35383F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="330" y="78" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">EN</text>
  </g>

  <!-- intro -->
  <text x="195" y="133" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Move around Tirana</text>
  <text x="195" y="160" text-anchor="middle" font-family="PT Sans" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#DADADA">Get your travel number and ride with ease.</text>

  <!-- centered red illustration shadow -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="313" r="119" fill="#000000" opacity="0.22"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="304" r="119" fill="url(#redGlow)" opacity="0.96"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="304" r="92" fill="#990000" opacity="0.52"/>
  <circle cx="107" cy="247" r="10" fill="#FEC949"/>
  <circle cx="285" cy="360" r="7" fill="#F8A0A0"/>
  <polygon points="112,345 155,278 178,345" fill="#FF4D4D" opacity="0.4"/>
  <polygon points="215,345 258,270 287,345" fill="#8B232359"/>

  <!-- bus illustration -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="115" y="247" width="160" height="106" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="115" y="247" width="160" height="32" rx="22" fill="#990000"/>
    <rect x="115" y="264" width="160" height="15" fill="#990000"/>
    <rect x="132" y="289" width="48" height="28" rx="5" fill="#35383F"/>
    <rect x="188" y="289" width="70" height="28" rx="5" fill="#35383F"/>

    <circle cx="145" cy="354" r="16" fill="#121826"/>
    <circle cx="245" cy="354" r="16" fill="#121826"/>
    <circle cx="145" cy="354" r="7" fill="#DADADA"/>
    <circle cx="245" cy="354" r="7" fill="#DADADA"/>
    <rect x="170" y="254" width="50" height="15" rx="3" fill="#FEC949"/>
    <text x="195" y="266" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto Mono" font-size="9" font-weight="700" fill="#121826">CITY RIDE</text>
    <circle cx="264" cy="255" r="5" fill="#FEC949"/>
  </g>

  <!-- information card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="448" width="342" height="120" rx="24" fill="#1D2230"/>
    <circle cx="55" cy="483" r="18" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
    <circle cx="55" cy="478" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <ellipse cx="55" cy="490" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="87" y="480" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">One number, every journey</text>
    <text x="87" y="503" font-family="PT Sans" font-size="14" fill="#DADADA">Your personal number helps you access</text>
    <text x="87" y="522" font-family="PT Sans" font-size="14" fill="#DADADA">routes, updates and your daily rides.</text>
    <line x1="42" y1="541" x2="348" y2="541" stroke="#35383F" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="554" r="3" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
    <text x="57" y="559" font-family="Roboto Mono" font-size="11" fill="#C4C4C4">Fast setup · Local routes · Simple travel</text>
  </g>

  <!-- progress -->
  <circle cx="178" cy="601" r="5" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="601" r="5" fill="#6C6C6C"/>
  <circle cx="212" cy="601" r="5" fill="#6C6C6C"/>

  <!-- button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="630" width="342" height="58" rx=" twenty" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
    <text x="195" y="666" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Get number</text>
    <polyline points="313,653 321,659 313,665" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="716" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto Mono" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#C4C4C4">It only takes a few seconds</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="758" width="390" height="86" fill="#181A20"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="758" x2="390" y2="758" stroke="#35383F" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,783 49,775 59,783 59,796 52,796 52,787 46,787 46,796 39,796" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
    <text x="49" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#FF4D4D">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="127" cy="783" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#6C6C6C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="127" cy="783" r="3" fill="#6C6C6C"/>

    <line x1="127" y1="788" x2="127" y2="793" stroke="#6C6C6C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="127" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#6C6C6C">Routes</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="195" y="774" width="22" height="17" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#6C6C6C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="780" x2="217" y2="780" stroke="#6C6C6C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="201" cy="785" r="2" fill="#6C6C6C"/>
    <text x="206" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#6C6C6C">Ticket</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="285" cy="780" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#6C6C6C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="285" cy="796" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#6C6C6C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="285" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#6C6C6C">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="354" cy="783" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#6C6C6C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="354" cy="783" r="3" fill="#6C6C6C"/>
    <rect x="352" y="770" width="4" height="4" rx="1" fill="#6C6C6C"/>
    <text x="354" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#6C6C6C">More</text>
  </g>
</svg>
